measuringSessionReading.grounds: Same shape as the two sibling validators in the same commit: the permission-flag update path lacked the caller-application ownership check on the referenced role; the fix adds it.

secondReader.sentence: Update validators for fieldPermission, objectPermission and permissionFlag only checked that the referenced role existed and was editable, never that the role belonged to the calling application; the commit adds validateRoleBelongsToCallerApplication to each update path so one application cannot target another application's role.
